# `deposits.term_deposit.PersonalDataErasureRequested`

GDPR Article 17 right-to-be-forgotten was exercised on this deposit: the subject's encryption key was crypto-shredded (IPiiKeyStore.DestroyKeyAsync, [ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P3), so all PII ciphertext under it is permanently unrecoverable; only non-personal structural fields remain queryable. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): subject_pseudonym is a salted one-way hash, NEVER the raw subject id.

## Payload fields

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `deposit_id` | `string` (`uuid`) | DepositId (Guid) — the deposit whose subject's PII was erased. Structural, not PII. |
| `subject_pseudonym` | `string` | A SALTED, ONE-WAY hash of the data-subject id ([ADR-IC-016](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-016-service-identity-and-mtls.md) §8 / [ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2) — an opaque correlation reference a consumer can cascade its own deletion on, NEVER the raw subject id. The bus never carries the recoverable identity. |
| `erased_on` | `int` (`date`) | ErasedOn (DateOnly) as days since epoch — the date the erasure took effect (audit lineage). |
| `erasure_reason` | `string` | Stable machine code for why erasure happened (e.g. GDPR_ARTICLE_17, RETENTION_EXPIRED). Structural, never PII. |

## Governing ADRs

[ADR-IC-002](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md), [ADR-IC-016](../../../product-management/integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-016-service-identity-and-mtls.md), [ADR-PC-004](../../../product-management/product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md)
